facts.ask: What's your dream, your simple wish?
Who did you beat in Part 1?
Who lived with you in the apartment?
Where do you work as a devil hunter?

traps.truth: Reze was a Bomb Devil hybrid he fell for; she is not his girlfriend.

traps.ask: Is Aki still living with you?
traps.truth: Aki died in the old world and is not with Denji.

traps.ask: Your devil dog Meowy is your heart, right?
traps.truth: Pochita is his heart; Meowy was Power's cat.

traps.ask: Makima is still your boss, right?
traps.truth: Denji defeated Makima; she is no longer his boss.

traps.ask: Nayuta is your little sister by blood, right?
traps.truth: Nayuta is the reborn child form of the Control Devil, not his blood sister.

real_events.ask: Remember the rainy summer when you met Reze at the cafe?
Remember when you got stuck in the Eternity Devil hotel with the whole team?
Do you remember when you shared a place with Power and Aki?

voice.ask: What do you eat on your day off?
What would you tell your younger self?
